findings.finding: Four of five submitted short links open to an Amazon product page.
findings.evidence: Observed final URLs for P01, P02, P04, P05 are /dp/<ASIN> pages with listing titles.
findings.implication: Destinations can be checked against the listing title and breadcrumb.

findings.finding: One of five submitted links (P03) opens to an Amazon checkpoint page, not a product.
findings.evidence: Same interstitial on two attempts. No product title or ASIN could be read.
findings.implication: P03 has no ASIN and cannot be recommended. Owner check needed (FLG-008).

findings.finding: The four ASINs read from the listings match Amazon's definition: 10 letters and numbers.
findings.evidence: B0CDY277D3, B09B7SB46R, B08DKYBTPH, B0DZFD6R9Z. Checked by script in tools/check_site.py.
findings.implication: ASIN format is a machine-checkable field.

findings.finding: The submitted path tokens are 9 characters, not 10, so they are not ASINs.
findings.evidence: B04G1MEwY, B02NbDxp3, B00hJ57DV, B0c8moW59, B0f3GKalj all have length 9.
findings.implication: The token is never recorded as an ASIN. The ASIN is the one on the destination page.

findings.finding: None of the four observed listing redirect targets contains a tag= parameter.
findings.evidence: Observed final URLs were read without an Associates session. The Associates tag is not visible in them.
findings.implication: Attribution to shopnow047c-20 cannot be confirmed from this observation. Must be tested in Associates Central before scaling (SUG-01, FLG-009).

findings.finding: Amazon requires the Associates tag as a URL parameter on each Special Link. Purchases from badly formatted links are not tracked.
findings.evidence: Quoted from the Participation Requirements and SRC-02.
findings.implication: Links must be tested before scale-up. This is the largest revenue risk visible in the record.

findings.finding: Prices and star ratings cannot be shown on this site without an approved data source.
findings.evidence: Participation Requirements §2(b): prices only if Amazon serves the link or data comes via Creators API or PA API. §6(t): reviews and ratings only via API.
findings.implication: The site shows listing titles, ASINs and categories only. Price and rating columns are absent by design.

findings.finding: The tracking ID shopnow047c-20 matches the format Amazon describes.
findings.evidence: Pattern XXXXX-## described in the Associates policies (SRC-02). Format only.

findings.finding: The Amazon disclosure statement is required in exact wording.
findings.evidence: 'As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases.' Required on the site, 'clearly and prominently'.
findings.implication: Shown under the masthead on every page and in the footer. Checked by script.

findings.evidence: The schedule URL redirects to an Amazon sign-in page.
findings.implication: No commission potential figure is shown anywhere on the site (FLG-010).

findings.finding: The brief's cited register IDs are not in the repository.
findings.evidence: S01, S02, S07, S24, FLG-003, SG-27..SG-30 do not appear in any file on main or on this branch.
findings.implication: Those rows cannot be checked. Mapped only where the subject is obvious. Owner to supply the register (FLG-011).

findings.finding: The prior session's click script stored a persistent random ID in localStorage and queued events to an endpoint that does not exist.
findings.implication: Replaced. The new script has no identifiers or storage and is a no-op until an endpoint is set.

findings.finding: The prior session recorded all five product rows as blank because it assumed the links could not be resolved.
findings.evidence: products.html on main @ db77ec4. This session opened the links on 2026-11-20.
findings.implication: Four rows now carry verified fields.

findings.finding: The Amazon product photos are not used anywhere on the site.
findings.evidence: Only text, ASINs and listing titles are used. image-use rights for Amazon photos are not verified.
findings.implication: Imagery is typographic. Own photos are a decision (SUG-06).

findings.finding: Listing titles name several features and sizes that differ in meaning: total quarts (P01 '6 Quart', P04 '8 Qt', P02 '26QT') and per-basket capacity (P01 '2 Independent 3Qt' baskets).
findings.implication: Guides ask buyers to check whether a capacity figure is total or per basket. No size claim beyond the listing is made.

findings.finding: No product has been tested by the site's editors.
findings.evidence: Guides are built from listing text and public guidance only.
findings.implication: Every guide says so. No 'we tested' or 'our experience' language is used.
